lockup down to 320px, so the rule is simply dropped.

`search: { exclude: true }` on each entry, keeping 100+ changelog pages
out of the search index. Blume 2 rebuilds a `custom()` source on the
scan's own context via `withContext`, which the wrapper inherited from
the source it spread, handing Blume back an unwrapped source and
silently dropping the exclusion. It now re-wraps on rebuild. The raw
source also moved to `blume/core/sources/github-releases.ts`, since
`blume/sources/github-releases.ts` is the new adapter factory.

Blume 2 replaces the keyed config blocks with adapters imported from
`blume/*` subpaths, so `blume.config.ts` moves to `vercel()` from
`blume/analytics` and `filesystem()`/`custom()` from `blume/sources`.
`ai.llmsTxt` becomes `agents.llmsTxt`, and the `deployment` block goes
away entirely since it only pinned `output: "static"`, now the default
when no host adapter is named.

header's right-hand action group. Blume 2 re-laid out the header and the
selector started matching the left branding group instead, so the logo
and the nav drawer toggle vanished on phones. Blume 2's header fits the
lockup down to 320px, so the rule is simply dropped.

`sources/github-releases.ts` wraps the release source only to stamp

out of the search index. Blume 2 rebuilds a `custom()` source on the
scan's own context via `withContext`, which the wrapper inherited from
the source it spread, handing Blume back an unwrapped source and
silently dropping the exclusion. It now re-wraps on rebuild. The raw
source also moved to `blume/core/sources/github-releases.ts`, since
